entities.summary: Manisa Celal Bayar University is a public research university located in Manisa, Turkey. CBU traces its roots back to 1959 as an independent sports and teachers' college in Manisa. The main campus is in the Muradiye district of Manisa. The university is composed of 14 colleges, 3 schools, and 15 vocational schools. As of 2017 university offers over 70 different undergraduate and over 90 graduate programs. Physical Education and Sports College is also one of the oldest institutions in Turkey that began offering sports science and physical education programs.
